prerequisites: Technical Drawing and the Gear Internship contained therein (recommended)

learning_outcomes.text: The students are able to explain the function of main structures, bearings, axles, shafts, seals and springs.
The students are able to design components functional and suitable for production.
The students are able to explain and apply the general procedure for the calculation of components.
The students are able to dimension springs according to load and function.
The students are able to apply basic CAD functions to be used for the design of components and for the creation of assemblies.
The students are able to solve constructive exercises and document and present the results.

syllabus_topics: Design tasks under consideration of the dimensioning and design rules for mechanical engineering components or assemblies
Solution concepts including description of the function
Technical drawings of the assembly with a list of parts
assessment_rules: To participate in the final module exam, students must pass the study achievement, which consists of a seminar paper on design concepts. 3 out of 4 tasks in the seminar paper must be passed. The final module exam, a written test of 120-150 minutes, determines 100% of the module grade. The ECTS credits are awarded upon passing the final module exam.
